note: Mobility and stretch movements, as ordinary content.exercises rows with an empty strength ontology. They are not strength-library exercises — that library is the subset with a populated ontology — and no progression metadata is invented for them. This exists so block_exercises.exercise_id stays the single content reference model rather than gaining a second shape for routine steps.
category_note: content.exercises.category is free text with no enum, and the seed already uses power/conditioning/strength/accessory/hyrox/cardio/core/recovery. Stretching shares the mobility category: nothing in the product distinguishes them and inventing a split nothing reads is how a vocabulary rots.
